sentences.en: Today, the White House defines a bona fide relationship.
sentences.zh: 今天，白宫对“真实的紧密关系”做出了界定。

sentences.en: Who's close family and who's not under the president's reinstated travel ban?
sentences.zh: 在总统恢复实施的旅行禁令下，谁才算近亲，谁又不算？

sentences.en: It's Friday, June 30th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月30日，星期五。

sentences.en: At 8 p.m.
sentences.zh: 晚上8点

sentences.en: on Thursday night, the Trump administration began enforcing a modified version of its travel ban
sentences.zh: 周四晚间，特朗普政府开始对来自六个主要为穆斯林国家的外国访客

sentences.en: on foreign visitors from six mostly Muslim countries and refugees from around the world.
sentences.zh: 以及世界各地的难民实施修改版的旅行禁令。

sentences.en: The Supreme Court had partially restored the ban on Monday, but ruled that it cannot be applied to people with a, quote, bona fide relationship to someone in the United States.
sentences.zh: 最高法院周一部分恢复了该禁令，但裁定它不能适用于与美国境内某人有着（引述）“真实紧密关系”的人。

sentences.en: Michael Scheer, what is the definition of bona fide?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·希尔，bona fide（真实）这个词的定义是什么？

sentences.en: And I'm going to elect to use that pronunciation rather than bona fide, just because it sounds too fancy.
sentences.zh: 我选择使用这种发音而不是 bona fide，纯粹是因为它听起来太做作了。

sentences.en: I think that's good.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这挺好。

sentences.en: I guess there's a couple different ways to look at this, right?
sentences.zh: 我想看待这个问题有几种不同的方式，对吧？

sentences.en: There's the dictionary definition, right, which means genuine and real, or it means made in good faith without fraud or deceit.
sentences.zh: 有字典上的定义，对吧，意思是真实的、真正的，或者指在没有欺诈或欺骗的情况下真诚做出的。

sentences.en: I think the more complicated question is trying to suss out the practical
sentences.zh: 我认为更复杂的问题在于，试图摸清在最高法院做出重大裁决之后，

sentences.en: and political definition as interpreted by a government agency in the wake of a big Supreme Court decision.
sentences.zh: 政府机构所解释的实际和政治定义。

sentences.en: So what is the Trump White House defining as a genuine and real relationship that would allow someone to come into the United States beginning now?
sentences.zh: 那么，特朗普白宫将什么定义为“真实而实际的关系”，从而允许某人从现在开始进入美国？

sentences.en: So what they're saying is basically that a set of family relationships, mother-father, sister-brother, mother-in-law, father-in-law,
sentences.zh: 所以他们所说的基本上是一组特定的家庭关系：母亲、父亲、姐妹、兄弟、岳母、公公、

sentences.en: but not grandmother, but not cousins or kind of a further relationship outside of what you would think of as your traditional kind of nuclear family.
sentences.zh: 但不包括祖母，不包括表亲或任何超出你传统核心家庭范畴的更远关系。

sentences.en: They say if a person applying for a visa to come into the United States from one of these six countries that the administration has focused
sentences.zh: 他们表示，如果一个申请签证准备从行政部门重点关注的这六个国家之一进入美国的个人，

sentences.en: on, or a refugee attempting to come into the United States from anywhere in the world,
sentences.zh: 或者一个试图从世界任何地方进入美国的难民，

sentences.en: if you have one of those relationships, then you can come in, assuming you aren't a threat in any other way.
sentences.zh: 如果你拥有这些关系之一，那么你就可以进来，前提是你不会在其他任何方面构成威胁。

sentences.en: If you don't have one of those relationships, and if you aren't a student admitted to a university here, or somebody who's been hired by a company, say Microsoft has hired
sentences.zh: 如果你没有这些关系，并且如果你不是被这里一所大学录取的学生，或者不是被某家公司雇用的人，比如微软雇用了

sentences.en: you to come in and work as a programmer or something, if you don't have one of those relationships
sentences.zh: 你来担任程序员或类似职位，如果你在美国没有这种

sentences.en: in the United States, you're out of luck and you're going to be kept out of the United States.
sentences.zh: 关系，那么你就很不走运，将被拒绝入境美国。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 真棒。

sentences.en: So let me lay out a few scenarios here, because it's pretty complicated who can come in now and who can't based on this word bonafide as it's being defined by the White House.
sentences.zh: 所以让我在这里列出几个情景，因为根据白宫对“真实”这个词的定义，现在究竟谁能进来、谁不能进来是非常复杂的。

sentences.en: Hey, Suzanne, it's Michael Barbaro from the Times.
sentences.zh: 嘿，苏珊娜，我是《时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: Yes, hi.
sentences.zh: 对，你好。

sentences.en: Thank you for making some time for me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你抽空接受我的采访。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: No problem.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: On Thursday afternoon, a few hours before the ban went into effect, I called Suzanne Ramazani.
sentences.zh: 周四下午，在禁令生效前几小时，我打电话给苏珊娜·拉马扎尼。

sentences.en: So you're getting married.
sentences.zh: 所以你们要结婚了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Tell me about it.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲吧。

sentences.en: So I'm a first generation American.
sentences.zh: 我是第一代美国人。

sentences.en: My mom is originally from Germany and my dad is originally from Iran.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈原籍德国，我爸爸原籍伊朗。

sentences.en: I recently became engaged to my boyfriend of six years on New Year's Eve.
sentences.zh: 我最近在跨年夜与交往六年的男友订婚了。

sentences.en: And we decided to set a date to get married next year, 2018.
sentences.zh: 我们决定定下明年（2018年）结婚的日子。

sentences.en: After we finish medical school, we're both third year medical students right now.
sentences.zh: 在我们读完医学院之后，我们现在都是医学院三年级学生。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, with this newly instated ban, this new term of who is a bonafide relative, really no one from my dad's side of the family is able to attend.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，随着这项新颁布的禁令和关于谁是“真实亲属”的新定义，我爸爸那边的亲戚真的没有一个人能来参加。

sentences.en: This is the Iranian side of the family.
sentences.zh: 这是指伊朗那边的亲戚。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So my mom's side from Germany is able to come.
sentences.zh: 所以来自德国的妈妈这边的亲人能够来。

sentences.en: But my uncles, my aunts, my cousins on my dad's side are all unable to attend.
sentences.zh: 但我爸爸那边的叔叔、阿姨、表亲都无法出席。

sentences.en: And just not a single member of this family from Iran, not a single family member.
sentences.zh: 而且来自伊朗的这个家族没有一个人能来，连一个家庭成员都没有。

sentences.en: And it's heartbreaking because I don't have anyone else.
sentences.zh: 这太令人心碎了，因为我没有别人了。

sentences.en: You know, I'm an only child.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我是个独生女。

sentences.en: We don't have any family here in the
sentences.zh: 我们在

sentences.en: United States.
sentences.zh: 美国没有任何亲戚。

sentences.en: My fiance is also an only child.
sentences.zh: 我的未婚夫也是独生子。

sentences.en: And, you know, to both of us, family is everything as is to most people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对我们俩来说，家庭就是一切，对大多数人来说也是如此。

sentences.en: And I just, you know, I really have no other words to say other than it breaks my heart.
sentences.zh: 我只是，你知道，除了心碎，我真的无话可说。

sentences.en: You know, I just want my family to be there on the most important day of our lives.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我只希望我的家人能在我们生命中最重要的一天在场。

sentences.en: Are you close to your family in Iran?
sentences.zh: 你和你在伊朗的家人关系亲密吗？

sentences.en: It sounds like you are.
sentences.zh: 听起来你们很亲近。

sentences.en: Oh, I very much am.
sentences.zh: 哦，非常亲近。

sentences.en: You know, I very much am.
sentences.zh: 你知道，真的非常亲近。

sentences.en: I had the opportunity to travel to Iran when I was 16.
sentences.zh: 我16岁时有机会去过一次伊朗。

sentences.en: And again, a couple years ago.
sentences.zh: 几年前又去过一次。

sentences.en: And when I went there for the first time, you know, this was right after 9-11.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次去那里的时候，你知道，那是在“9·11”事件之后不久。

sentences.en: I had no idea what to expect.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: I thought that things would be very different.
sentences.zh: 我以为情况会大不相同。

sentences.en: I didn't know how people would respond.
sentences.zh: 我不知道人们会有什么反应。

sentences.en: And I had the complete opposite experience where there was so much love and people wanting to know about, you know, American culture, what music I listened to.
sentences.zh: 但我有了完全相反的经历，那里有那么多的爱，人们想了解美国文化，了解我听什么音乐。

sentences.en: It was just such a wonderful experience for me that I wish more people understood Iranian people, that it's not.
sentences.zh: 那对我来说是一段非常美好的经历，我希望更多人能理解伊朗人民，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: What I see more of the issue is that it's our governments against each other, and it's not the people.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，更多的问题在于我们的政府互相对抗，而不是人民本身。

sentences.en: You know, I don't see that many differences between us.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我看不出我们之间有那么多不同。

sentences.en: So, President Trump is defining this phrase, bonafide relationship, one way.
sentences.zh: 所以，特朗普总统对“真实关系”这个词给出了一种定义。

sentences.en: How do you define it?
sentences.zh: 你是如何定义的？

sentences.en: You know, I don't think you can define a relationship.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为你无法定义一种关系。

sentences.en: I don't think you can define who is family and who is not.
sentences.zh: 我认为你无法定义谁是家人，谁不是。

sentences.en: You know, I understand the fear of terrorism.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我理解对恐怖主义的恐惧。

sentences.en: I, you know, recently there was a terrorist attack in Iran.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道，最近伊朗发生了恐怖袭击。

sentences.en: I, I understand that.
sentences.zh: 我，我理解这一点。

sentences.en: I just, to me, I don't understand how preventing family members who have a direct connection to people here in the U.S., how that hinders terrorism.
sentences.zh: 只是对我而言，我不明白阻止与美国境内的人有直接联系的家庭成员入境，这怎么能阻碍恐怖主义。

sentences.en: You know, when I heard that it was originally people who had no connection, you know, that made a little bit more sense to me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我听说最初针对的是那些没有任何联系的人时，你知道，这对我来说更有道理一些。

sentences.en: But having, you know, having the government define who has a relationship and who does not, I think it's still a very murky subject.
sentences.zh: 但是让，你知道，让政府来定义谁有关系、谁没有，我认为这仍然是一个非常模糊的话题。

sentences.en: And I, I just wish people had more understanding of the impact it has on people here in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我，我只希望人们能更多地理解它对美国境内人们的影响

sentences.en: as well.
sentences.zh: 也是如此。

sentences.en: Well, Susanna, I want to thank you and tell you mazel tov on your upcoming wedding.
sentences.zh: 好吧，苏珊娜，我要感谢你，并祝贺你即将到来的婚礼。

sentences.en: Congratulations.
sentences.zh: 恭喜。

sentences.en: Thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Michael, another scenario.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克尔，另一种情景。

sentences.en: I am a Syrian grandmother living in the United States and my grandchild lives in Syria and is now suddenly an orphan.
sentences.zh: 我是一个住在美国的叙利亚祖母，我的孙辈住在叙利亚，现在突然成了一个孤儿。

sentences.en: And as, as involved and maybe as dramatic as that sounds, there are so many orphans in Syria who have grandparents in the United States because of the civil war there.
sentences.zh: 听起来可能很复杂也很戏剧化，但由于那里的内战，叙利亚有那么多孤儿在美国有祖父母。

sentences.en: So now as a grandmother, I want to raise this orphan grandchild in the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以现在作为祖母，我想在美国抚养这个孤儿孙辈。

sentences.en: Can I bring this grandchild to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我现在能把这个孙辈带到美国

sentences.en: right now?
sentences.zh: 吗？

sentences.en: It appears not.
sentences.zh: 似乎不行。

sentences.en: I mean, again, I think under the rules, that child would not be able, unless they had some other relative that was a parent or a sibling in the United States,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，再说一次，我认为根据规则，那个孩子将无法前来，除非他们在美國有其他亲戚是父母或兄弟姐妹，

sentences.en: that, that person would not be able to come over because they don't have a connection to the United
sentences.zh: 那么，那个人将无法过来，因为他们与美国没有

sentences.en: States that is in the, the words of the government, bona fide relationship.
sentences.zh: 用政府的话说属于“真实关系”的联系。

sentences.en: When it comes to this word bona fide, why did the government not just list the relationships that if you're in one mean you can come in?
sentences.zh: 当谈到“真实”（bona fide）这个词时，为什么政府不直接列出那些只要符合就能进来的关系？

sentences.en: For example, if you have a parent here or a sibling here, you can come in.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你这里有父母或兄弟姐妹，你就可以进来。

sentences.en: If you don't, you know, sort of tough luck.
sentences.zh: 如果没有，你知道，那就只能自认倒霉了。

sentences.en: Why instead is the government introducing this idea of categorizing forms of relationships as, as kind of a hierarchy of real or authentic or not?
sentences.zh: 为什么政府不这样做，反而引入了这种将关系形式分类的想法，将其视为真实与否的某种层级？

sentences.en: Why use this word bona fide at all?
sentences.zh: 为什么还要使用“真实”（bona fide）这个词？

sentences.en: So I think if this had been a decision solely of an administrative part of government, meaning the executive branch, I'm not sure they would have, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我想，如果这完全是政府行政部门做出的决定，也就是行政分支，我不敢肯定他们会这样做，对吧？

sentences.en: I think they would have probably gone the direction that you're suggesting, which is simply to offer a liSt. These are in, those are out.
sentences.zh: 我想他们可能会走向你所建议的方向，也就是简单地提供一个名单：这些可以，那些不行。

sentences.en: But remember that where that word, that phrase came from wasn't the executive branch.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，这个词、这个短语的来源并非行政分支。

sentences.en: It was the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 而是最高法院。

sentences.en: And I'm not a Supreme Court reporter, but my sense is that the world that the
sentences.zh: 我不是最高法院的记者，但我的感觉是，最高法院大法官们生活的世界，

sentences.en: Supreme Court justices live in, not, not one of kind of black and white lists, but one of general principles that they're trying to elucidate.
sentences.zh: 不是那种非黑即白的清单世界，而是他们试图阐明的一般原则的世界。

sentences.en: And so look, decades and decades of Supreme Court jurisprudence has been about laying out a general principle that they think meets the sort of test
sentences.zh: 所以你看，几十年来最高法院的判例一直致力于阐述他们认为符合合宪性或合法性标准的

sentences.en: of constitutionality or legality.
sentences.zh: 某种一般原则。

sentences.en: And then the rest of the government has to go ahead and figure out what that means.
sentences.zh: 然后政府的其他部门必须继续弄清楚这意味着什么。

sentences.en: And I don't think this is any different in that respect from what the court generally does.
sentences.zh: 在这方面，我认为这与法院通常的做法没什么不同。

sentences.en: They don't want to get into the nitty gritty.
sentences.zh: 他们不想陷入繁枝末节。

sentences.en: Nobody elected the Supreme Court justices to sort of get down on into the weeds and decide whether a sister-in-law is better than a grandma or vice versa.
sentences.zh: 没有人选举最高法院大法官来深入细枝末节，去决定嫂子是不是比奶奶更好，反之亦然。

sentences.en: So the court is basically saying, look, what we're after here, the general principle that we're after
sentences.zh: 所以法院基本上是在说，听着，我们在这里追求的目标，我们在这里追求的

sentences.en: here is that if somebody is coming to the United States, they've got to have a pretty good connection,
sentences.zh: 一般原则是，如果有人要来美国，他们必须有相当不错的联系，

sentences.en: you know, something that ties them here versus somebody who really doesn't have any connection to the United States.
sentences.zh: 你知道，某种将他们与这里联系起来的东西，而不是那些与美国真的没有任何联系的人。

sentences.en: They're not a citizen.
sentences.zh: 他们不是公民。

sentences.en: They don't know a citizen.
sentences.zh: 他们不认识公民。

sentences.en: They just want to come here, right?
sentences.zh: 他们只是想来这里，对吧？

sentences.en: And I think from the court's perspective, that type of person isn't entitled to the same kinds
sentences.zh: 我认为从法院的角度来看，那种人无权享有美国公民或美国居民

sentences.en: of protections and rights that certainly citizens of the United States or residents of the United States
sentences.zh: 当然能够享有的同等保护和权利，或者他们会辩称，我猜，那些与受保护者紧密相连的人。

sentences.en: are, or they would argue, I guess, somebody who is closely connected to somebody that is protected.
sentences.zh: 这就是一般原则。

sentences.en: So that's the general principle.
sentences.zh: 然后由政府其余部门去弄清楚这到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: And then it's up to the rest of the government to figure out sort of what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 以及我们如何把细节补充完整？

sentences.en: And how do we put the how do we put the details on it?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我对于这一切为什么会发生感到非常困惑，因为这是最高法院同意审理一个案件的结果，但要等到10月。

sentences.en: Michael, I'm pretty confused about why this is happening at all, because this is a result of the
sentences.zh: 截至目前，所有下级法院都已否决了总统针对这些主要为穆斯林国家的旅行禁令。

sentences.en: Supreme Court agreeing to hear a case, but not until October.

sentences.en: security related, that's even a more powerful incentive for the courts to defer to them unless there's something really wrong.

sentences.zh: 如果是的话，我们认为在他想做的事情中，有哪些部分是在没有严重侵犯人们权利的情况下，

sentences.en: on people who are not citizens of the United States, are not residents of the United States,

sentences.en: Hmm.

sentences.zh: 我想他们的论点会是，任何想要来这里、在这里没有任何纽带的人，

sentences.en: here, doesn't, you know, is more suspicious, is somebody who you don't know why they're trying to come to the United States.

sentences.zh: 因此，我想在政府看来，这样的人

sentences.en: If you, by contrast, have a connection to the United
sentences.zh: 相比之下，如果你与美国

sentences.en: You know, I, I mean, I'm not sure that holds together logically, because I think there's a real question of whether it does.

sentences.en: Because, because let's say that, you know, cynically, you say, well, well, the person that you want to keep out is the 19 year old Muslim kind of radical that you think
sentences.zh: 因为，因为假设，你知道的，以小人之心度之，你会说，你想挡住的人其实是19岁的穆斯林激进分子，你认为

sentences.zh: 他更有可能成为恐怖分子，对吧？

sentences.zh: 但同样是这个人，如果他声称有个兄弟，

sentences.en: then he can come.
sentences.zh: 那他就能来。

sentences.en: He can come.
sentences.zh: 他就能来。

sentences.en: Nobody has expressed to me, and I don't actually see the logic of why, if they, if they were sort of trying to like design a system to target a particular age group,

sentences.en: this wouldn't be the way you would do it.
sentences.zh: 这绝对不会是你会采用的方法。

sentences.en: You could imagine a system whereby they said, you know, we're going to add scrutiny to people between the ages of 17 and 26.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象这样一个系统：他们说，我们要对17到26岁之间的人加强审查。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So there's no clear pattern here from what you can tell about, about age or, or kind of demographics beyond...

sentences.en: No, and in fact, in fact, there's really no explanation that they've given us at all for the different kinds of family.
sentences.zh: 没有，事实上，对于不同类型的家庭，他们根本没有给我们任何解释。

sentences.en: Like people said on the call with the State Department today, isn't it true that there are some people who are, you know, raised by their grandmother since
sentences.zh: 就像今天在与国务院的电话会议上人们所说的那样，难道没有这样的人吗：他们从小

sentences.zh: 三岁起就由祖母抚养长大，你知道，他们的父母死于车祸之类的事情，他们

sentences.en: After pledging the total repeal of the Affordable Care
sentences.zh: 在承诺彻底废除《平价医疗

sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，麦康奈尔正在考虑保留针对投资收益的平价医疗法案税收，以满足像参议员鲍勃·科克这样抱怨

sentences.en: It's not equitable to have a situation where you're increasing the burden on lower-income citizens and lessening the burden on wealthy citizens.
sentences.zh: 出现这样一种局面是不公平的：一方面增加低收入公民的负担，另一方面减轻富裕公民的负担。

sentences.en: That's not a proposition that is sustainable.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个可持续的主张。

sentences.en: And I think leadership knows that.

sentences.zh: 对，我刚刚才看到不久。

sentences.en: Obviously, I don't see that as an appropriate comment.

sentences.en: MSNBC's Morning Joe.
sentences.zh: MSNBC的《早安，乔》。

sentences.en: I said no.

sentences.zh: 没有什么比炮制一本关于自己的杂志假封面更让人爽快的了，里面全天候谎话连篇，毁掉国家。

sentences.en: It's a good feeling.

sentences.en: Including a segment Thursday morning in which Brzezinski criticized the president for, among other things,
sentences.zh: 其中包括周四早上的一个节目片段，布热津斯基在其中批评总统，原因之一是

sentences.en: Deputy White House Press Secretary Sarah Huckabee Sanders says Trump stands by his tweet.
sentences.zh: 白宫副新闻秘书萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯表示，特朗普坚持自己的推文。

sentences.en: Did the president go too far with this tweet in its deeply personal nature?
sentences.zh: 总统这条带有极强个人色彩的推文是不是做得太过了？

sentences.en: I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that the president has been
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为总统

sentences.en: attacked mercilessly on personal accounts by members on that program.
sentences.zh: 一直遭到该节目成员在个人层面上的无情攻击。

sentences.en: And I think he's been very clear that when he gets attacked, he's going to hit back.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他已经表态得很清楚，当他受到攻击时，他会进行反击。

sentences.en: I think the American people elected somebody who's tough, who's smart, and who's a fighter.

sentences.en: And that's Donald Trump.
